blocks.html: Chapter 7 asked “what is our best estimate, and how precise is it?” For the urban and rural children of §7.2.3 the answer was a difference in mean weight of 1 kg, 95% CI 0.20 to 1.80 kg. This chapter asks a related question of the same data: is the evidence strong enough to reject a stated claim, such as “the true difference is zero”? It builds the logic and vocabulary shared by every test (§8.1–8.7) and ends with a table that matches each study design and outcome to its test and model (§8.8). The specific tests follow in Chapters 9 and 10.
